name: Picture motion
responsibility: Turns one scene into the next as a pure function of a progress value: it pairs groups by subject id and mixes their typed geometry, opacity and transforms
description: The entrance, the departure, the far swap and the flight into a card follow the same rule. Nothing here draws, reads a clock or keeps state between frames, so the same inputs give the same items. The durations come from the page that hosts the painter. flight.rs holds what moves a whole picture: a flight from the last picture, a part-by-part entrance, a leaving picture, the ghost of one that left, and the model inside a card that the camera flies into.
